rationale: Price has been in a steady five-candle decline since entry (12.52 → 12.43), is now sitting just $0.04 above the $12.38 invalidation level, and has failed to reclaim the 9-EMA ($12.45) — the very level that anchored the original long thesis. The maximum favorable excursion was only 0.24% while adverse excursion has reached -0.60%, indicating the breakout attempt has stalled and sellers are in control near the session high. Closing now preserves capital before the automated stop is hit at a slightly worse price, and avoids the risk of a sharper flush through $12.38 with 75 minutes remaining.
